title: Twisted Bernoulli Zeros in Quasi-Linear Time: Distribution, Depth, and Explicit Hilbert Class Components
summary: The divided generalized Bernoulli values $b_{χ,j} = fB_{1,χω^{-j}} \bmod p$, for $χ$ an odd primitive Dirichlet character of conductor $f$ and order $d$ with $d \mid p-1$, control (for $p \nmid \varphi(f)$) the odd isotypic components of the $p$-class group of $Q(ζ_{fp})$ through the characterwise abelian Main Conjecture; a zero is a twisted irregular pair, a branch with positive Iwasawa lambda-invariant, in the tradition studied by Ernvall, Holden, Delbourgo-Knospe and Knospe.
